articles.title: Tyrannosaurus rex Had Mammal-Like Body Temperature, Study Finds - Sci.News
articles.description: A new analysis of Tyrannosaurus rex teeth indicates the ancient predator maintained a body temperature of about 36.3 degrees Celsius (97.3 degrees Fahrenheit), close to that of Indian and African elephants and far warmer than its cold-blooded reptile neighbor…
